entities.name: UAC-0056
entities.gloss: A threat actor group, also tracked as DEV-0586 and unc2589, known for cyber espionage and disruptive attacks against Ukraine.

entities.name: CredPump
entities.gloss: An SSH backdoor implemented as a PAM module that provides covert remote SSH access and logs credentials.

entities.name: HoaxPen
entities.gloss: A backdoor malware designed to execute arbitrary commands on compromised Unix-like systems.

entities.name: HoaxApe
entities.gloss: A backdoor implemented as an Apache web server module to execute arbitrary commands.

entities.name: GOST
entities.gloss: A cross-platform tunnel and proxy tool written in Go, used for network forwarding.

entities.name: Ngrok
entities.gloss: A cross-platform reverse proxy software used to expose local network ports to the public internet.

entities.name: P0wnyShell
entities.gloss: A lightweight, single-file PHP web shell used to execute commands on compromised web servers.

entities.name: Apache
